evidence.detail: The class is an abstract direct subtype of R287 TimedInterfaceTask; its constructor only supplies the interval to the shared elapsed-time gate and it adds no hover/deferred/render state.
TimedInterfaceTask owns a dedicated int-keyed InterfaceTaskRegistry typed specifically to rs/n/b/a/a, separate from the R288 DeferredHoverTask and InterfaceRenderTask registries.
The only exact-v308 concrete subtype is R285 EventActivityViewerRefreshTask, registered under interface 30072 with a 500 ms interval.
That concrete task periodically rewrites the Event Activity Viewer text rows from the activity model list, establishing the subtype's refresh/update role rather than hover or render-phase work.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the dedicated timed interface-refresh subtype. The only concrete v308 consumer is EventActivityViewerRefreshTask.
